name: Nicolae Ștefănuță - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Belgium – EGF/2025/006 BE/Audi
part_text:
The European Parliament approves giving Belgium 7.5 million euros from a European fund that helps workers who lose their jobs. The money comes after carmaker Audi closed its Brussels plant, where one model was built, and let 3,414 workers go, including staff at five suppliers. The cash pays for job counselling, training, help starting businesses and small allowances. Belgium covers the remaining 15 per cent of the 8.9 million euro total.

- Around 3,414 former Audi and supplier workers in Belgium can get counselling, training and allowances.
- Belgium receives 7,527,625 euros, which is 85 per cent of the 8,856,030 euro support package.
- Parliament and Council leaders sign the decision, then the money is paid from the 2026 European Union budget.
